## Self-review checklist
<!-- Required when no second reviewer is available (CIS §22.3). -->
- [ ] Scope matches the CIS §22.5 plan for this PR; no later-PR or later-milestone work
- [ ] Commits and PR title follow Conventional Commits 1.0.0 (CIS §22.4)
- [ ] Required CI checks and tests pass; none skipped, weakened or disabled
- [ ] No unrelated files changed; no unrelated refactoring
- [ ] No dependency or version changed silently (D-82)
- [ ] "Not Implemented" lists everything intentionally excluded
